name: Nurse Nessa Handwritten Nursing Notes (600+ Pages)
seoTitle: Nurse Nessa Nursing Notes for NCLEX Study
metaDescription: Nurse Nessa's 600+ pages of handwritten nursing notes, made for NCLEX prep. A generous, useful gift for a nursing student heading into boards.
summary: Over 600 pages of handwritten nursing notes from Nurse Nessa, built around NCLEX prep. A generous, practical gift for a student facing boards.
whyItWorks: Few things weigh on a nursing student like the NCLEX. After graduation, there is usually a stretch of intense studying before the exam, and anything that makes that time feel more organized is a gift. Nurse Nessa's notes are handwritten, which many visual learners find easier to review than dense textbook pages, and with more than 600 pages, they cover a lot of ground.

A study resource can feel less exciting to unwrap than jewelry or a mug, but students often remember the people who helped them through boards. It is a thoughtful gift from parents, a mentor, or a nurse who has been through the exam and knows how much support matters. Consider giving it right after graduation or the pinning ceremony, when study plans are just starting. Pair it with highlighters, sticky tabs, and a good coffee for a full study kit. It shows you are invested in their success, not just celebrating the diploma.
goodToKnow: Check the listing to see whether it is a printed book, a digital download, or both.
Best for students in their final semester or recent grads preparing for the NCLEX.
Some students already have a study program, so ask about their plan if possible.
